hook: orphan 悲傷團來領雨傘：bemoan／deplore／aggrieve／condole——失物處廣播「請帶手帕」。
script: bemoan／deplore 哀嘆。aggrieve 使悲痛。condole 慰問。careworn 憔悴。calumny 誹謗也讓人傷心。口令：雨傘寫「撐住」，慰問寫「我在」。

members.senseAnchor: to feel sorry or dissatisfied about
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 長嘆: bemoan walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「長嘆」出場：bemoan 一上場梗就黏住——哀嘆。

members.senseAnchor: express strong disapproval of; regret strongly
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 搖頭嘆: deplore walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「搖頭嘆」出場：deplore 一上場梗就黏住——悲嘆譴責。

members.senseAnchor: infringe on the rights of; cause to feel sorrow
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 傷心事: aggrieve walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「傷心事」出場：aggrieve 一上場梗就黏住——使悲痛。

members.senseAnchor: express one's sympathetic grief, on the occasion of someone's death
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 拍肩: condole walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「拍肩」出場：condole 一上場梗就黏住——慰問。

members.senseAnchor: showing the wearing effects of overwork or care or suffering; ; ; ; - Charles Dickens
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 疲憊臉: careworn walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「疲憊臉」出場：careworn 一上場梗就黏住——憔悴的。

members.senseAnchor: a false accusation of an offense or a malicious misrepresentation of someone's words or actions; an abusive attack on a person's character or good name
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 髒話紙: calumny walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「髒話紙」出場：calumny 一上場梗就黏住——誹謗。

related.synonyms: defamation, calumniation, obloquy, traducement, aspersion, slander

members.senseAnchor: charge falsely or with malicious intent; attack the good name and reputation of someone
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 造謠筆: calumniate walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「造謠筆」出場：calumniate 一上場梗就黏住——誹謗。

related.synonyms: defame, slander, smirch, asperse, denigrate, smear

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 輓歌: lament walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「輓歌」出場：lament 一上場梗就黏住——哀悼。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 望窗: wistful walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「望窗」出場：wistful 一上場梗就黏住——惆悵的。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 空站台: forlorn walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「空站台」出場：forlorn 一上場梗就黏住——孤苦的。

members.senseAnchor: a feeling of thoughtful sadness; a constitutional tendency to be gloomy and depressed
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 藍調: melancholy walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「藍調」出場：melancholy 一上場梗就黏住——憂鬱。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 手帕: handkerchief walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「手帕」出場：handkerchief 一上場梗就黏住——手帕。
members.vocabNote: 留在幽默庫作構詞／劇本用；暫不列入 GRE 難詞主庫，避免稀釋考點密度。

pitfalls: condole≠console 完全同義使用時仍要看搭配
